evidence: The owner, 2026-08-27, designing the Blood City process: feedback comes in bigger chunks and creation should be automated as far as it will go. Said to the agent in conversation on 2026-08-27; not quoted in the repository (docs/history/llmapper_level_understanding_handbook/HANDOFF-ARCHITECT-2026-09-01.md restates it: 'Owner review is batched, never blocking').
use: Proceed when the automated checks pass; flag what only a player can judge.
